mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE rising above 4.5% over the past three months) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and weak economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST show month-over-month growth, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 310), the Federal Reserve is expected to implement aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 310, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1 > 22900) reflects robust economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 exceeds 22900, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong monthly job growth rate (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals a tight labor market and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy actions increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1300) indicates robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1300, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
